stages.title: Stage 34 — Reverse Engineering Graphics

details.title: Graphics Reverse Engineering Checklist
items: Identifying Custom View implementations and `onDraw` Canvas operations
Tracing Jetpack Compose UI trees and `$composer` layout nodes
Identifying OpenGL ES context initialization and GLSL shader code
Locating Vulkan instance creation and SPIR-V shader payloads
Tracing Camera2 preview pipelines and `ImageReader` frame listeners
Identifying `MediaCodec` initialization, MIME types, and surface bindings
Identifying custom Animation frameworks and physics interpolators
Auditing native graphics libraries (`.so`) compiled with Skia or custom C++ engines
Tracing interactions between UI framework APIs, native libraries, and system daemons

items: `frameworks/native/opengl/` - EGL and OpenGL ES wrapper libraries

Focus on: View draw calls traversal, BufferQueue state transitions, SurfaceFlinger composition passes, and hardware video decoding pipelines
